Fixes: typos, quotation marks and the course subtitle; R comments moved onto their own lines so the code runs. On instructor request the GIF of slide 14 is replaced by the same scene as a YouTube video (https://youtu.be/lK4ouRWGHHI), played in a privacy-enhanced youtube-nocookie player when the deck is opened over the web, with a still and a link otherwise. Original slide pictures are re-drawn at their source positions in brand colours; one light-based HTML switches theme at runtime with dark figure and collage variants attached by CSS, and the remaining theme font references point to SameTone. Instructor notes are not authored for this deck. No private notes or local paths are published.
